descriptions.claude: 動詞単位の skill ({{core_skills}}) を「弱いモデル基準のレール + 賢いモデルへの opt-out (手順自由・出口固定) + hooks floors」で構成する Claude Code plugin / Agent Skills skill pack。タスクの回し方が強くないモデルには番号付き手順を、強いモデルには余計な手順を課さず出口の形だけ揃える設計。
descriptions.cursor: hikizan for Cursor: bundles the verb skills ({{core_skills}}), agents, beforeShellExecution floors (force-push deny, destructive-op ask, non-draft PR deny), and an always-apply rule for routing conventions + standard-tier opt-out preamble.
descriptions.codex: hikizan for Codex: bundles the verb skills ({{core_skills}}), PreToolUse floors (force-push deny, destructive-op deny, non-draft PR deny), and the routing conventions + standard-tier opt-out preamble via SessionStart.

codexInterface.shortDescription: Japanese workflow skills and safety floors for Codex
codexInterface.longDescription: Verb-oriented Japanese workflow skills, routing conventions, and deterministic Codex hook guardrails for push, pull request, and destructive shell operations.
